title: MIZAN Court Session Artifact v1
description: Append-only artifact produced by a MIZAN court-session step (real or simulated). Artifacts record observations and outputs with provenance; they never self-promote into Accepted Fact. Promotion to ACCEPTED_FACT happens only in the governed private runtime through explicit owner review, and is therefore not a state of this schema.

artifact_id.description: MIZAN-owned stable locator for this artifact. Assigned by MIZAN, never by an engine.

session_id.description: Identifier of the court session this artifact belongs to.

step_index.description: Ordered position of the producing step within the session.

delegation_mode.description: MIZAN_HANDLES: MIZAN performs the step autonomously under governance. TOGETHER: shared MIZAN/owner execution. OWNER_HANDLES: owner performs the step; MIZAN records only.

epistemic_class.description: Epistemic state of the artifact content. SIMULATION_OUTPUT marks courtroom-simulation content and must never be read as case fact. ACCEPTED_FACT is deliberately not a state of this schema: acceptance is a governed runtime decision, not an artifact property.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical artifact content bytes.

actor.description: Producing component or role, e.g. mizan-agent:clerk, owner, engine:paddleocr.

engine.description: Engine that produced the content, when applicable. Engine identity never replaces the MIZAN artifact identity.

content_ref.description: Stable locator of the stored content (MIZAN-owned path/URI).

prior_artifact_id.description: Previous artifact in the append-only chain for this session, or null for the first artifact.

source_document_locator.description: MIZAN stable locator of the source document span this artifact derives from, when applicable.

provenance.description: Traceability back to a source artifact and SHA-256.

notes.description: Free-text note. Must not contain real case party identities.
